study_note: One seed55 H3/J8/K1 Humanoid Walk pilot, 400k decisions, BOOM exact replay-action likelihood at lambda=0.0042. Preserve S>2 gate, Q/S weights and division by S, post-tanh alpha=0.0021, strict compilation, whole-inner CUDA graphs, vmap, GPU replay, TF32-high and critic geometry. Sparse isolated gradient probes and actual Adam/policy-change diagnostics calibrate coefficient strength; all 16 checkpoints retained every25k.
